entities.name: James S. Davenport
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: James Sanford Davenport was a U.S. representative from Oklahoma and a member of the Oklahoma Court of Criminal Appeals. He served on the congressional committee that created the first roads and highways committee in the U.S. House.
